method: Read primary paper HTML and arXiv version histories, official evaluation pages and author repositories through web tools. No third-party code installed or executed; no GPU/model requests.

local_baseline_checks.finding: Current Franzen configuration sets ARC3_MEMORY_SECTIONS='off'. World/Goal section code exists but is not an enabled baseline capability.

The off switch removes carried memory sections, guidance, nudges and parsing; memory-section output returns empty. Offline annotation may reuse field concepts, but online reenabling is a separate prompt/memory intervention.
